description: This file defines classes and enums for managing a WebChat UI component on macOS, including a custom panel, a singleton WebChatManager, and related presentation logic.

classes.name: WebChatPanel
classes.description: A borderless NSPanel subclass that can accept key focus for typing.

classes.name: WebChatPresentation
classes.description: An enum that specifies presentation modes (window or panel) for the web chat, including an associated anchor provider.

classes.name: WebChatManager
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing web chat sessions, windows, and panels, providing methods to show, toggle, and reset chat UI components.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the web chat for a given session key, creating a window if necessary.

methods.name: togglePanel
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the web chat panel associated with a session key, presenting anchored if needed.

methods.name: closePanel
methods.description: Closes the current panel if it is open.

methods.name: preferredSessionKey
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the preferred session key, caching the result.

methods.name: resetTunnels
methods.description: Closes and clears all session-related windows and panels, resetting cache.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Resets all web chat UI components and session data.

methods.name: panelHidden
methods.description: Handles panel hide event, notifying via callback.
